write_up: A recruiter can see an experienced math teacher with classroom-based digital learning design work. The teaching work is easy to place, though the professional learning community line leaves a question about what you lead the group to do.

The Canvas module is your best model: it names the Algebra II unit, what you changed, and where students use it. Your certificate in progress and portfolio point toward more learning design work without claiming a separate design role.
